study: An autonomous laboratory for the accelerated synthesis of inorganic materials
scope: Public article, corrected article text, Supplementary Information, Supplementary Data description, and linked public code repositories

statusVocabulary.available: Machine- or human-readable records are publicly accessible for the stated unit.
statusVocabulary.partial: Only a subset, aggregate, figure, or derived record is public.
statusVocabulary.notLocated: The audit did not locate a public record at the stated unit; this does not prove that the record does not exist privately.

components.limitation: The table is a target registry, not an experiment ledger.

components.location: The article reports 353 attempts in aggregate.
components.limitation: No public table was located with one stable identifier per attempt and its target, precursor set, process, observation, adjudication, and policy decision.

components.location: Article Figure 2 and aggregate 30% recipe target rate
components.limitation: Plot markers are not a lossless table and do not expose full recipe, intermediate-phase, uncertainty, or decision-provenance fields.
The table is a many-to-one derivative of attempts and cannot reconstruct which observation caused each update.
The archive description covers successful syntheses and does not constitute raw, uniformly adjudicated data for all 353 attempts.

components.location: No complete failed-attempt archive was located in the public supplements.
components.limitation: Without raw negative observations, phase-label errors and alternative failure taxonomies cannot be independently replayed.
Target-level post-hoc categories do not label every failed recipe and can mix physical failure with measurement or model failure.

components.location: ARROWS code documents the policy class and file format.
components.limitation: The campaign's candidate set, rejected alternatives, scores, model versions, random state, and action probability at each step were not located.

components.location: Methods, Supplementary Note 9, Supplementary Figure 6, and AlabOS documentation
components.limitation: Per-attempt deviations, instrument calibration state, exceptions, and recovery actions were not located.
A complete attempt-level confusion matrix between autonomous and independent calls is not public.

conclusion: The public record supports target-level outcome claims and exposes important derived reaction knowledge, but it is insufficient for deterministic replay or unbiased re-estimation of the 353-step search policy.
